recentItems.title: Zelenskyy’s energy ultimatum? Either a truce, or Russia will freeze
recentItems.description:
Strikes on Russian refineries, Yandex outages, and the energy ceasefire — Ukraine responds to Russian attacks. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy declares readiness to halt energy strikes under the condition of mutual actions by Moscow. We analyze the diesel deal between Trump and Putin, its impact on the market, and Kyiv's reaction.

The Armed Forces of Ukraine destroyed a drone workshop in the Donetsk region and thwarted Russian plans near Lyman, while BARS interceptor drones hit five out of five targets.

Additionally: a shadow fleet tanker intercepted by France, new EU aid, and the threat of a global food crisis. How did strikes on Yandex data centers paralyze digital services and bot activity? Watch all the details on News Pulse.

recentItems.title: TRUMP NEGOTIATED — PUTIN BETRAYED THE DEAL! Russia violates energy ceasefire
recentItems.description:
Zelenskyy stated that Ukraine did not attack Russian oil refineries for two days, while Russia continued striking Ukrainian energy and critical infrastructure, targeting 19 regions.

The EU has agreed to open two negotiation clusters for Ukraine and is preparing new restrictions against Russian oil. Germany is organizing a meeting of the "coalition of the willing," while Estonia supports Ukraine's accession to NATO.

Also in this issue: drone attacks on commercial vessels near Bulgaria and France's interception of a suspected Russian shadow fleet tanker in the Indian Ocean. Watch for key international news and statements.

recentItems.title: "Highway of death" for the Russian army: Drones cut off Crimea & burn hundreds of trucks monthly!
recentItems.description:
The war in Ukraine, Defense Forces strikes on Russian supply routes to Crimea, battles for the Donbas, and a tanker fire near Sochi — featured in this edition of Front News.  

How are Ukrainian drones disrupting the occupiers' supplies along the land corridor? The "Skelya" and "Azov" units conducted a joint operation in the Dobropillia direction, successfully halting the Russian advance on a crucial sector. We also examine attacks on commercial vessels in the Black Sea and the fire aboard a Russian shadow fleet tanker.

Additionally in this issue: the story of 15-year-old Maksym, who survived a strike on a post office in Synelnykove, Estonia's defense reinforcement, and Medvedev's threats against Armenia. Watch for a comprehensive overview of the front line and the consequences of Russian aggression.
